### [Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta](https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/astabrief)

**Hugging Face** · 2026-10-02

Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) has open-sourced AstaBrief, a specialized language model designed for fast academic and technical report generation within the Asta platform.

- AstaBrief is designed to accelerate the automated generation of structured academic summaries and research briefs.
- The model artifacts, weights, and evaluation code have been made publicly available on Hugging Face by Ai2.

**Why it matters:** Open-sourcing AstaBrief provides developers and researchers with a dedicated model for high-speed technical report synthesis and automated academic literature aggregation.

### [Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-frontier-academy)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-02

Anthropic launched the Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027.

- Program structure consists of a multi-day in-person workshop, a graded practical exam, and a 12-week residency leading an enterprise Claude project.
- Curriculum covers simulated enterprise deployments from initial use-case selection through security review to handover.
- Initial enterprise cohorts include engineers from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, and Novo Nordisk across San Francisco, New York, and London.
- Graduates earn the Claude Resident Engineer badge after the initial phase and the Claude Frontier Deployed Engineer badge following final assessment at the end of the 12-week residency.

**Why it matters:** It establishes a structured, vendor-led residency framework to upskill enterprise software engineers in deploying production-ready agentic AI systems directly within large organizations.
